summary: The change limits staging sign-in to emails in a Secret Manager allowlist. It checks the list when Better Auth creates a user or session and again when the control plane reads a session. A refused sign-in carries the NOT_INVITED code so the OAuth callback redirects to its error page. Every changed line is now covered or exempt for a reason I accept, the temp tests pass, and earlier findings F1 to F4 are resolved, so the change is ready.
